parts.text: Devus to Revex (review) and Orc: PR #11 for issue #10. Base dev 445bd063cb0dbaa5b73591ac91649a969e7beeeb; source (tested) 0cb4a5fd69ba114c1ec20d0dc846c1e02f6b5013; generated kit 97f2b29c1cebed940cacfffd9af009edf672425d (console-kit.html only, SHA-256 dae233e54155a17863ee9249c8c244022cb9208f166081357c6d34d9ce054aa1, byte-identical in two clean Node 24 builds); the PR HEAD adds only this message. Cause: the header search input reserved 44px for the clear button while ConsoleHeader places the '/' hint at right 48px, inside the text area. Measured on dev in the HTTP example and the offline file: placeholder under the hint at 992-1056px in light and dark (960px in dark), typed text 24px under it at every width 640-1440px. Fix in Console's source: ConsoleHeader measures the hint (ResizeObserver) into --wl-search-hint-space; console-parts.css makes the input reserve 48px + hint + 8px with an ellipsis; provenance recorded. New tests/search-hint.spec.ts fails on dev and passes on the candidate (HTTP and file://, light and dark, 13 widths; '/' shortcut kept). Playwright 65 passed; Node 24 container checks pass. Parity run with a dev control: only the prototype screens at 360px change (about 146 px each): the frontend baseline has the same overlap and the candidate ends with an ellipsis; a deliberate difference for Orc to list; other cells equal the control or known launch-to-launch cells. Before/after crops at 1024px and the parity crop are on evidence branch claude/10-evidence-1024px at 95999337118a0a1605f5c86ce4ac5e9d84ca0cc1. No merge.
